# TABLES
customers (4,000 rows; one row per customer)
  customer_id VARCHAR -- unique customer key, customer_city VARCHAR -- city of the customer, customer_region VARCHAR -- one of North/South/East/West/Central, signup_date DATE -- date the customer registered, acquisition_channel VARCHAR -- organic, paid_search, social, email, affiliate
sellers (180 rows; one row per seller (marketplace merchant)
response:
WITH order_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_purchase_ts) AS quarter,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_status <> 'canceled' THEN o.order_id END) AS orders_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_status = 'canceled' THEN o.order_id END) * 1.0
            / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS cancellation_rate,
        AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_purchase_ts >= DATE '2025-04-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_ts <  DATE '2025-10-01'
    GROUP BY quarter
),
item_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_purchase_ts) AS quarter,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_status <> 'canceled' THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_purchase_ts >= DATE '2025-04-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_ts <  DATE '2025-10-01'
    GROUP BY quarter
)
SELECT
    om.quarter,
    om.orders_count,
    ROUND(om.revenue / NULLIF(om.orders_count, 0), 2) AS aov,
    ROUND(om.cancellation_rate, 4) AS cancellation_rate,
    om.avg_review_score
FROM order_metrics om
JOIN item_metrics im ON im.quarter = om.quarter
WHERE om.quarter IN (DATE_TRUNC('quarter', DATE '2025-04-01'), DATE_TRUNC('quarter', DATE '2025-07-01'))
ORDER BY om.quarter;
